result.title: LagNet: Lag-Structured Operators for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
result.summary: Long-term time series forecasting maps a finite history window to an extended future horizon. Many existing models focus primarily on the design of input representations and model structures, while paying less attention to the structural form of the history-to-future forecasting operator itself. We examine this operator directly and find that, across model families, sensitivity matrices exhibit recurring diagonal patterns whose diagonals correspond to relative temporal lags. Motivated by this observation, we develop a framework for direct multi-step forecasting based on lag-structured temporal operators. Its basic building block, LagLayer, constructs a Toeplitz matrix by tying history-to-future connections with the same relative lag and incorporates horizon-wise and history-wise scaling coefficients to relax exact sharing. This design enables LagLayer to serve as an effective replacement for temporal linear layers in existing forecasting models. Stacking LagLayer modules with activations and multiple feature maps yields LagNet. Experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks show that our method is competitive with strong baselines, while sensitivity matrix diagnostics and limited-data experiments demonstrate that LagLayer provides an effective and sample-efficient alternative to a linear layer.

AI.brief_summary: 论文直接考察长期时间序列预测中「历史窗口到未来」的预测算子，发现不同模型族的敏感度矩阵普遍呈与相对时间滞后对应的对角结构，据此构造按相同相对滞后共享连接的 Toeplitz 算子 LagLayer，并堆叠为 LagNet，在基准上与强基线相当且更样本高效。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按相对位置/滞后绑定权重」的结构化算子与敏感度矩阵诊断，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新算子的参数共享形式（如按相对深度或位置共享）及内部状态诊断提供可核查的借鉴线索，但领域较远，需先确认结构假设是否可迁移。
